text: You are sworn of the jury for the town of Bristol. By the oath you have taken, you will answer truly to the articles of our lord the king, and conceal nothing.
speaker: p245

text: The next article. Has any sheriff, bailiff, or other officer of the king, taken anything from any man, to do his office, or to leave it undone?
speaker: p245

text: Think carefully before you answer, master. The commissioners ride on tomorrow. I stay here.
speaker: p273

text: Write it down, clerk. Two shillings, taken by the bailiff of the castle, to release goods held without cause. The king shall hear of it.
speaker: p245

text: You'll be bringing goods past the castle again, I expect. I shall remember you.
speaker: p273

text: Nothing? Nothing at all? Very well. Clerk, write: the jurors know of nothing. The next article.
speaker: p245

text: Wise man. You'll find the castle gate opens easier for friends.
speaker: p273
